meta.name: Tyler Perry's Divorced Sistas
meta.description: Five friends - Rasheda, Geneva, Naomi, Tiffany, and Bridgette - support each other through divorce, marriage, dating, healing, and friendship struggles while their loyalty and sisterhood bonds are tested.

videos.title: The Pretty Lady
videos.overview: Geneva, Tiffany and Rasheda confront personal betrayals as tensions rise while preparing for a church banquet, and Naomi seeks revenge on her ex-husband amid her tumultuous divorce.

videos.title: Old Flames, New Scars
videos.overview: As Bridgette grapples with Vaughn's persistent immaturity and his inability to hold a job, she faces a crossroads between love and self-discovery.

videos.title: Hushed Tones
videos.overview: Javon makes a wild declaration to Geneva, but when he doesn't get the response he's looking for, he attempts to make her jealous; Bridgette feels uncomfortable introducing Vaughn and causes a rift between them.

videos.title: A Line in the Sand
videos.overview: Naomi lashes out in response to her ex-husband's ultimate act of disrespect, and Rasheda and Pastor Jefferson have a moment of hurtful truths.

videos.title: Breath of Fresh Air
videos.overview: Naomi feels overwhelmed by the harassment from her ex-husband and flirts with the idea of a permanent solution.

videos.title: Heavier Than Words
videos.overview: Geneva confronts Yara with false intentions of a playdate between their daughters, and Pastor Jefferson learns disturbing news about his wife's past.

videos.title: Brutal Honesty
videos.overview: Bridgette, Pastor Jefferson and Rasheda get to the bottom of Vaughn's actions, Geneva and Tiffany face the growing tension between them, and Naomi spills many painful truths.

videos.title: Birds of a Feather
videos.overview: Rasheda and Pastor Jefferson navigate the tumultuous waters of their parental roles as Laz's explosive outburst fractures their family dynamic; amid a whirlwind of unforeseen events, Anika's sudden trip to the hospital ignites unsettling questions.

videos.title: Lies in Disguise
videos.overview: Grayson, Naomi and Franklin's son, is pitted between them and their obsession to ruin one another. Vaughn returns, and Bridgette must decide if she will cave and take him back or stand her ground and be done with their relationship

videos.title: A Little Grace
videos.overview: William confides in Pastor Jefferson regarding his family woes. Naomi takes advantage of Tiffany's relationship with Javon by asking him for a favor that could possibly help her avoid jail time

videos.title: Dangerous Games
videos.overview: In a tangled web of secrets, Geneva fights to keep her burning desires hidden. Naomi reveals shocking information about her ex-husband to Hakeem, igniting him to enact their plan.

videos.title: Disappearing Act
videos.overview: Myron shares private information about Kalvin's marriage with Tiffany. Javon and Tiffany's bond deepen into something serious, but it is littered with hidden secrets and ulterior motives.

videos.title: Beyond Redemption
videos.overview: Naomi's plan unfolds as Hakeem takes his position, ready to strike. Rasheda and Pastor Jefferson make a desperate attempt to help resolve Geneva and William's marital issues.

videos.title: Honesty Hour
videos.overview: Grayson's doubts about his mother's secrets hit a crisis. William's buried anger toward Geneva sparks a dangerous affair that could destroy everything.

videos.title: Seeing Red
videos.overview: Geneva comes home to an unpleasant surprise, and her emotions cause her to commit irrevocable actions; Grayson learns of his father's demise and immediately goes to visit the most likely suspect.

videos.title: Author of Confusion
videos.overview: William's fate hangs in the balance as everyone rushes to his aid, and Geneva spins out of control over their fight. Hakeem meets with Naomi to settle up on their agreement, but things don't go according to plan.
